method: Unprofiled budget-only CardRasterCache policy (candidate), not production integration. The only source difference is the constructor default budget 48 to 16 MiB; run-start exact byte comparison enforces this. Both sides retain identical current production peak accounting, mask packing, art, thresholds, allocation, transfer, draw order, timers and completion method. Vite redirects only current PaintedCardBatches './card-raster-cache' to the frozen 5b original module or archived standalone candidate class; all methods and defaults come from that complete class. The frozen original must equal current cache source bytes. Both external modules are imported before cycles without instantiating classes. Original complete class has a 50331648-byte (48 MiB) budget; candidate complete class is expected to supply 16777216 bytes (default 16777216, 16 MiB). The CLI budget argument validates, never mutates, the constructor default. Before/empty/returned counters strictly validate the selected budget and encoded payload bytes. Encoded entries retain the unchanged 1024 bound. Neither provider has probation metadata; its reported validation fields are null/not applicable, and captured actual stats reject admission, probation or ghost fields. Scratch/JS metadata are not claimed bounded by encoded payload budget. This isolates only the default budget; codec, get, put, release, admission and backoff implementation bytes remain unchanged. Budget-dependent behavior may differ. No per-frame instrumentation is introduced. Cache statistics, true Canvas miss counts and CPU ownership may differ and remain fully reported. Equal PNG RGBA, masked picking, snapshot facts and requested times are correctness requirements to verify separately; page and upload behavior must also be compared from evidence rather than assumed equal. Frozen clocks remain 18 preparation draws at n=0..51, 60 CPU warmups, 60 paced=true CPU samples at n=114 and 12 real frames at n=480, preserving the original first cold-stream sample and empty/return probes. Default one-lifetime pilot; repeat count 2 is recorded explicitly. Any later ABBA is externally scheduled. The original preparation, warmup, first cold sample and all sample clocks are retained without selection. CPU samples retain the original renderer.render no-op; real complete wall includes Canvas/submission/GPU completion/scheduler overhead. No new observer or picking calls. Output directories are exclusive to preserve prior headers and failed evidence.
